idea-plugin.name: XLS Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Read-only XLS viewer with workbook diff.

Opens legacy Excel 97-2003 workbooks (.xls) and renders them the way Excel does: fonts, fills, borders, alignment, text wrapping, merged cells, frozen panes, row heights, column widths and number formats. Two workbooks can be compared side by side with change markers, and unchanged rows and columns can be collapsed.
